name: Dorchester County, MD
findings: Dorchester County has 116 nonprofit organizations. 53 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Dorchester County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Dorchester County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 39 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
